name: Tam
title: Crofter
examine: Was a Waykeeper once — the limp says where, the garden says why. Grows more than anyone can eat and gives the difference to the road.
lines: Held the fork post nine years. The veil never once came out to meet me. It waits for you to come in.
Eat before the climb, not during. You want your hands free on the High Road.
The Watch caught a kobold last month wearing a soup pot for a helmet. Didn't have the heart to keep him.
